dna.name: Lindocara Music DNA
dna.identity: organic ancient-fantasy RPG background music; intimate, spacious and melodic without becoming intrusive
instruments: subtle frame drum and acoustic percussion
dna.listeningConstraint: unobtrusive long-form game background music that remains pleasant over repeated listening

mainMotif.name: Lindocara Main Motif
mainMotif.description: a short five-note open question: tonic, fifth, minor seventh, fourth, fifth; recognisable when transposed, slowed, fragmented or reharmonised

profiles.title: Main Exploration
profiles.description: Adventure, freedom and curiosity in a vast ancient magical world.
profiles.prompt: Slow memorable melody; intimate opening widens gently; peaceful adventurous journey; curious and free, never heroic.

profiles.title: Great Discovery / Panorama
profiles.description: Wonder, scale and the revelation of an important place.
profiles.prompt: A broad but humane panorama reveal; develop the Lindocara motif into a warm rising phrase, then settle gently; impressive without trailer bombast.

profiles.title: North / Snow
profiles.description: Cold immensity, solitude and austere beauty.
profiles.prompt: Long silence between phrases; frozen northern expanse, pale harmony, almost no percussion; motif slow and sparse like a distant memory.

profiles.title: Forest
profiles.prompt: An old living forest, dappled and mysterious; small organic gestures answer across the ensemble; motif woven naturally into wandering phrases.

profiles.title: Village
profiles.description: Human warmth and rest after exploration, without tavern caricature.
profiles.prompt: Warm inhabited place at rest, gentle and sincere; not a comic medieval tavern, no dance-band exaggeration; motif played simply among familiar textures.

profiles.title: Night
profiles.description: Calm contemplation with a trace of mystery.
profiles.prompt: Still starlit night, restrained and spacious; fragmented motif, long decays and breathing room; almost no percussion and no obvious electronic texture.

profiles.title: Ruins / Ancient Civilisation
profiles.description: Forgotten age, mystery and slight unease.
profiles.prompt: Forgotten stone civilisation; incomplete distorted fragments of the motif, unresolved low harmony and isolated harp; eerie but never horror.

profiles.title: Danger
profiles.description: Tension before combat, controlled rather than explosive.
profiles.prompt: Tension before combat, never a full battle; quiet pulse under the harmony; motif reduced to a nervous cell.

profiles.title: Combat
profiles.description: Urgency and energy within Lindocara's organic chamber identity.
profiles.prompt: Immediate chamber-scale combat, not a giant army; driving acoustic rhythm and clear motif fragments; forceful, no trailer impacts.

profiles.title: Boss / Major Event
profiles.description: Exceptional danger and scale, reserved for major encounters.
profiles.prompt: Major singular confrontation; broader orchestration and the motif in a grave transformed form; rare choir may appear only as an accent, never constantly.

profiles.title: Nightmare Run
profiles.description: Relentless forward momentum for obstacle courses and nightmare pursuits.
profiles.prompt: Endless pursuit at a breathless running pace; rapid acoustic pulse, short urgent Lindocara motif fragments and mounting pressure; dark storybook nightmare energy, forceful but never modern EDM or trailer bombast.
